_doc: FluentCommunity vendor-map per PRINCIPLES-VENDOR.md V11. One row per touched ability. Populated incrementally as fix packages land.

abilities.notes: Package 3 V2 canonical namespace fix. Prior registrar called Space::create(['type'=>'course']); the BaseSpace::boot creating hook reads the model's static $type property, so Space (static $type='community') overwrote the passed type and persisted type=community — causing all downstream course/lesson/enrollment reads to return 'Course not found' (7 cascade failures). Course model (static $type='course') uses the same hook correctly. Slug uniqueness check still uses Space::withoutGlobalScopes() to detect conflicts across all space types (community/course/sidebar_link share the slug-unique constraint on fcom_spaces).
Package 3 V2 canonical namespace fix (cascade of create-course fix). Uses Course model which has a type=course global scope, replacing the legacy Space::where('type','course') pattern.

Package 3 V2 canonical namespace fix. Prior registrar referenced FluentCommunity\App\Services\Helper\Utility (drifted namespace); installed vendor exposes the helper at FluentCommunity\App\Functions\Utility. Returns vendor_helper_unavailable WP_Error when class absent.

Package 3 V2 canonical namespace fix. Same namespace drift as get-customization-settings. Registrar sanitizes yes/no enum + affiliate_id integer before forwarding (input whitelist). Wraps call in try/catch; vendor Throwable returns WP_Error vendor_precondition_failed.
Package 3 V2 canonical namespace fix. Same namespace drift as get-customization-settings.

Package 3 V2 canonical namespace fix. Prior registrar referenced FluentCommunity\App\Models\NotificationPref (wrong namespace); the class is a Services helper, not an Eloquent model. Installed vendor exposes it at FluentCommunity\App\Services\NotificationPref.
Package 3 V2 canonical namespace fix. Same namespace drift as get-notification-prefs. Vendor helper applies internal validKeys allowlist and np_by_* per-space key normalization.

Package 2 V10 signature-alignment fix (F-COM-04). Vendor SettingController::updatePrivacySettings(Request $request) expects a vendor Framework Request, not an array — registrar previously passed an array and produced a PHP TypeError. Registrar now routes through the vendor public helper Utility::updatePrivacySettings($settings) (V3 priority 2 — the same call the controller invokes internally, which applies the vendor Arr::only allowlist + vendor storage/cache invariants). When the vendor helper is absent, returns WP_Error('vendor_helper_unavailable', …) — no raw update_option() fallback (would bypass V7 input whitelist and V3 vendor storage semantics; reviewer-flagged on P2 PR #83).
